fields.name: below

fields.name: clip

fields.name: body

elems.name: grid

fields.name: children

elems.name: footer

fields.name: repeat

fields.name: children
fields.doc: The cells and lines within the footer.

elems.name: hline
elems.title: Grid Horizontal Line

fields.doc: The row above which the horizontal line is placed (zero-indexed). If the `position` field is set to `{bottom}`, the line is placed below the row with the given index instead (see @grid.hline.position for details).

fields.name: end

fields.name: stroke

fields.name: position

elems.name: vline

fields.name: start
fields.doc: The row at which the vertical line starts (zero-indexed, inclusive).

fields.name: end
fields.doc: The row on top of which the vertical line ends (zero-indexed, exclusive). Therefore, the vertical line will be drawn up to and across row `end - 1`.

fields.name: stroke
fields.doc: The line's stroke.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: The position at which the line is placed, given its column (`x`) -- either `{start}` to draw before it or `{end}` to draw after it.

fields.name: y

fields.name: stroke

fields.name: margin

fields.name: foreground

fields.name: gap

fields.name: justify

fields.name: dx

fields.name: y

fields.name: body

fields.name: ay
fields.doc: The vertical skewing angle.

fields.name: origin

fields.name: reflow

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The content to skew.

fields.doc: The base to which things are attached.

fields.name: b

fields.name: bl

fields.name: tr

elems.name: primes

elems.name: scripts

fields.name: size

fields.doc: A supplement for the equation.

fields.doc: Whether to use bold glyphs.

fields.name: locale

fields.name: denom
fields.doc: The fraction's denominator.

fields.doc: How the fraction should be laid out.

fields.name: denom-deparenthesized

fields.doc: The binomial's upper index.

fields.parse: let values = args.all::<Spanned<Value>>() ?; if values.is_empty() { bail !(args.span, "missing argument: lower"); } values.into_iter().map(| spanned | spanned.v.display()).collect()

fields.name: augment

fields.parse: let mut rows = vec ![]; let mut width = 0; let values = args.all::<Spanned<Value>>() ?; if values.iter().any(| spanned | matches !(spanned.v, Value::Array(_))) { for Spanned { v, span } in values { let array = v.cast::<Array>().at(span) ?; let row : Vec<_> = array.into_iter().map(Value::display).collect(); width = width.max(row.len()); rows.push(row); } } else { rows = vec ![values.into_iter().map(| spanned | spanned.v.display()).collect()]; } for row in &mut rows { if row.len()<width { row.resize(width, Content::empty()); } } rows

fields.doc: The operator's text.

fields.name: limits
fields.doc: Whether the operator should show attachments as limits in display mode.

fields.doc: Which root of the radicand to take.

fields.name: radicand
fields.doc: The expression to take the root of.

elems.name: underline
elems.title: Underline
elems.doc: A horizontal line under content.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The content above the line.

elems.name: overline

elems.doc: A horizontal line over content.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The content below the line.

fields.name: counter

fields.name: locale
